content: 1 A Song of Ascents. When Jehovah{H3068} brought back{H7725} those that returned{H7725} to Zion,{H6726} We were like unto them that dream.{H2492} 2 Then was our mouth{H6310} filled{H4390} with laughter,{H7814} And our tongue{H3956} with singing:{H7440} Then said{H559} they among the nations,{H1471} Jehovah{H3068} hath done{H6213} great things{H1431} for them. 3 Jehovah{H3068} hath done{H6213} great things{H1431} for us, [Whereof] we are glad.{H8056} 4 Turn again{H7725} our captivity,{H7622} O Jehovah,{H3068} As the streams{H650} in the South.{H5045} 5 They that sow{H2232} in tears{H1832} shall reap{H7114} in joy.{H7440} 6 He that goeth{H3212} forth{H1980} and weepeth,{H1058} bearing{H5375} seed{H2233} for sowing,{H4901} Shall doubtless{H935} come{H935} again with joy,{H7440} bringing{H5375} his sheaves{H485} [with him].
